narrative: Policy WTP-PLS-200118, Mei Lin Zhou. My suitcase didn't arrive with me when I landed at Haneda on 11 September at 14:20. The airline gave me a delay report at the baggage desk and delivered the bag to my hotel the next evening at 20:30. Until then I had to buy toiletries ($38.50), a shirt and trousers ($214.00) and underwear and socks ($29.99). Total $282.49. Receipts and the airline report are attached.
